state.decision: Make the keyframe card's Ease in % and Ease out % editable (Figma B3 right panel; plan row 11.134 numeric ease), asked before coding (user, 24 Nov 2026: build the missing Editor UI).
state.facts: The card already shows Ease out (the leaving key's curve x1 as a percentage) and Ease in (1 minus the previous key's curve x2), read-only. A segment between two keys is one cubic bezier (x1,y1 leaving handle; x2,y2 arriving handle), with endpoints fixed at 0 and 1; x values must stay in 0..1; y is the speed side and may overshoot. The stored easing can be Linear, Hold, Ease in, Ease out, Ease in-out or a custom bezier, and updateKeyframe and planSetSegmentBezier already write a custom bezier on the leaving key. A Linear segment has handles on the diagonal (0,0) and (1,1). Rule: never show a control that does nothing; a value shown must be one the scene holds. The Ease in field belongs to the segment that ARRIVES at the selected key, so it writes the previous key's bezier; with no previous key it has nothing to edit.
state.proposed: Typing a percentage in Ease out sets x1 of the segment leaving the selected key to value/100 (clamped 0.1 to 100 percent), and Ease in sets x2 of the arriving segment to 1 minus value/100, always as a custom bezier written on the key that owns the segment. The y of the handle is kept when the segment is already curved; for a Linear segment the handle stays on the straight line (y equals x) so typing a number changes nothing visible until the other handle is moved, and a Hold segment is not editable. Fields show a dash and are disabled when there is no segment on that side.

linear.instructions: What should typing an influence on a Linear segment do?

criteria.A: Convert it to a custom bezier whose handle slides along the straight line, so the curve stays linear until the other handle moves (as proposed).
criteria.B: Convert it to a custom bezier with a flat handle (speed 0 at the key), like Easy Ease with the typed influence, so the curve visibly eases.
criteria.C: Refuse and ask the operator to pick Ease first.

range.instructions: Which range should a typed influence accept?

criteria.A: 0.1 to 100 percent, the contract's x range; anything else is clamped (as proposed).
criteria.C: Any number; refuse values outside 0 to 100 with a message.

hold.instructions: What should the field do when the segment is Hold?

criteria.A: Show a dash and be disabled, because a held segment has no curve (as proposed).
criteria.B: Convert the segment to a custom bezier when typed into.
criteria.C: Show the number 0 and accept typing.
